name: Shellback
bio: Slow to anger, slower to move, and nobody has ever knocked him over.
notes: Drive intake of 2026-11-06 ("The object resembles a humanoid tortoise", as Meshy names the download; the owner's "new turtle"; rigged and animated on Meshy: Mixamo joint names read as Meshy's; finger chains without an index finger, so the fingers are re-fitted by hands.mjs; the tail's extra joints ride the hips; its two clips are not used). A humanoid tortoise with a high domed shell, a long neck and a short tail. Standard size (the owner, 2026-11-06: "should be smaller, not that big at all"; it came in large, 2.12 m, for its broad, heavy body). It takes Bamboo's place: saved choices of Bamboo play it. 199k triangles: rebaked. The owner kept the name (2026-11-06).
